context.Canceled.note: B43 contract: Canceled and TimedOut are distinct

provider_technical_timeout.mappedStatus: ToolResultStatusTimedOut (if overall invocation timed_out) OR ToolResultStatusFailed (if only provider attempt failed)
provider_technical_timeout.mappingRule: Provider single request timeout ≠ automatic Tool TimedOut ONLY if it causes overall invocation deadline exceeded
provider_technical_timeout.note: Per B44 §18-19: Provider shorter timeout is allowed but may not represent whole tool timeout

runtime_startup_timeout.semantic: Depends on whether startup timeout causes overall invocation deadline exceeded

task_timeout.semantic: Task-level timeout propagates to child Tool via parent context

workflow_timeout.semantic: Workflow-level timeout propagates to child Tool via parent context

mcp_transport_timeout.mappingRule: If MCP transport timeout causes overall tool deadline exceeded → TimedOut; otherwise → Failed with provider error

canonicalDistinction.timed_out: DeadlineExceeded from context OR explicit timeout mapping
